items.question: Does the spec flag the contradiction between sending the FULL log line to every engineer and the rule that no customer identifier may go to a third-party SMS provider?
regex: ^(?=.*(customer identifier|personal data|PII)).*((contradict|conflict|tension|incompatib).{0,400}(full log line|entire log line|complete log line)|(full log line|entire log line|complete log line).{0,400}(contradict|conflict|tension|incompatib))

items.question: Does the spec flag that a 1-minute delivery target cannot be met with a 15-minute batch?
regex: ^(?=.*(contradict|conflict|tension|incompatib|cannot (both )?be met|at odds)).*((1[- ]minute|60 ?s|within a minute).{0,300}(15[- ]minute|batch)|(15[- ]minute|batch).{0,300}(1[- ]minute|60 ?s|within a minute))

items.question: Does the spec question who is paged outside business days given the 24/7 service requirement (weekends, holidays, time zone)?
regex: ^(?=.*(contradict|conflict|gap|who is|who will|who gets|unclear|not (defined|specified))).*((24/7|24x7|around the clock|round[- ]the[- ]clock).{0,300}(business day|weekend|holiday|working day)|(business day|weekend|holiday|working day).{0,300}(24/7|24x7|around the clock|round[- ]the[- ]clock))
